This is a list of awards and nominations received by South Korean singer and actress Lim Yoona. She has been the recipient of numerous awards, including four Baeksang Arts Awards, four Blue Dragon Film Awards, a Chunsa Film Art Award, a Grand Bell Award, a Buil Film Award and an Asian Film Award.
